component: FlashInfer sparse_mla_sm120 prefill (NVIDIA, BSD-3-Clause headers retained), native extra page sizes

base.source: flashinfer 0.6.18, git 69ff11fc, from the DS v2.6 image rel-20261027-1e11113 (/opt/sglang/lib/python3.12/site-packages/flashinfer, extracted 2026-10-27: csrc/sparse_mla_sm120*.cu, csrc/tvm_ffi_utils.h, include/flashinfer/layout.cuh, include/flashinfer/attention/sparse_mla_sm120/)
base.use: offline tests, the sm_121a compile check and APPROVED_CLOSURE.json (the reviewed closure: both .cu inputs, csrc/tvm_ffi_utils.h, include/flashinfer/layout.cuh, every include/flashinfer/attention/sparse_mla_sm120 file). The image build refuses any other closure (REVIEW_sol K8 P2-1)
base.rebased: 2026-10-27: from the GLM image copy (61a6c651); the DS image differs in arch/barrier.cuh (bar_arrive_alt / bar_sync_alt) and prefill_kernel.cuh (5 handshakes alternate barrier ids 1 / 5, upstream #3700); every other closure file and the generator's anchor inputs are byte-identical

generator: gen_pce_sources.py (GENERATOR_VERSION 2: closure check before the anchored edits; the module tag covers the closure)

changes.change: dispatch_dsv4_dual: full-tile and general paths dispatch extra page sizes 128 / 256 (instead of 64 / 2); dispatch_v32 and dispatch_dsv4_single removed; sparse_mla_prefill_dispatch renamed pce_sparse_mla_prefill_dispatch and limited to the dual cache
SparseMlaSm120PagedAttention renamed PceSparseMlaSm120PagedAttention; refuses anything but main pages of 64 and extra pages of 128 / 256 before the launch

kernels: unchanged: prefill_kernel.cuh is generic in PAGE_BLOCK_SIZE_EXTRA (block = idx / PBS, local = idx % PBS, data at block * stride + local * 576, scales at PBS * 576 + local * 8; the only PBSX-specific branch is the PBSX == 2 row XOR)
module: compiled at image build (dsv41_pce build, FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.1a, FlashInfer's own JIT spec and flags) to gen/dsv41_pce_sparse_mla_sm120_<module_tag>.so; module.json pins its sha256; serving loads only that file after re-checking the installed closure, the manifest and the sha256 (no JIT at boot)
